project_overview.project_name: Full Stack Developer Needed – Billing Software (Flutter + NestJS)
project_overview.project_summary: This software / digital product project centers on Full Stack Developer Needed – Billing Software (Flutter + NestJS). The initial brief says: I am looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer to build a modern, responsive, mobile-first Billing & Invoicing Software with support for multiple companies and Indian GST. Tech Stack (Mandatory) Flutter (Web, Android, iOS, Windows, macOS) NestJS (TypeScript) PostgreSQL Prisma ORM Redis Docker & Docker Compose Ubuntu VPS Key Requirements Multi-company & multi-user support Indian GST (optional) Multiple invoice templates CSV/XLS/XLSX import & export PDF invoice generation Daily automatic backup & restore Responsive and elegant UI/UX Clean, scalable, well-documented code A detailed feature specification is attached and must be followed. The work sits mainly in Software development, Mobile applications, Web, Mobile & Software Dev. Stable project themes include authentication and access, administration and reporting, payments and billing, analytics and reporting, outbound communication, responsive or multi-platform presentation, application apis. The available evidence includes 147 conversation messages, 1 attachment files, 1 deliverable files, which together document the brief, collaboration, review cycle, and delivered work. The recoverable artifacts span .docx, .pdf formats; their contents were used only where they supplied stable domain, production, architecture, or handoff information. For engineering onboarding, the key task is to understand the product workflows, component boundaries, integrations, data responsibilities, and the evidence level behind each implementation claim before changing code. A repository link appears in the project evidence, but its contents could not be inspected in the current environment; implementation claims therefore remain limited to the local sources and conversation.
